units: Approximate mm from molded metric ruler, not verified physical mm
coordinate_convention: u follows increasing ruler ticks; v is transverse image direction. Origin is first sampled pin. Neither axis is a registered console coordinate.
uncertainty: No calibrated numerical error bound. Molded body scale and pin plane differ; camera pose, paper curvature, pin contact band, fabric compression and repeatability are unknown.

records.title: Lower crease / front transition
records.interpretation: Likely longitudinal section through the lower transition. Exact X station and contact plane are unrecorded.
records.purpose: Lower console-side relief and phone seating transition; does not alone establish an XY corner radius.
records.caveat: The sheet is visibly curved. The curved endpoint reaches the lowest pins, so the complete transition may not be captured.
records.measurement_status: Provisional image evidence; not safe for automatic CAD import

records.title: Left wall to pad
records.interpretation: Crosswise capture of the left wall/pad transition, apparently in the lower region. Exact Y station is unrecorded.
records.purpose: Left external edge relief. Preserve the requested 2 mm inset until a console datum is registered.
records.caveat: A wall blend is visible, but the photo does not establish wall position relative to the nub centerline or the full pad baseline.
records.measurement_status: Provisional image evidence; not safe for automatic CAD import

records.title: Short left nub, lengthwise
records.interpretation: Likely lengthwise section through the short left nub. Its exact lateral alignment and gauge tilt are unrecorded.
records.purpose: Asymmetric longitudinal end slopes. A vertical section does not specify the rounded XY end outlines at each height.
records.caveat: The broad upper feature and end transitions need registration to physical nub endpoints before changing opening length.
records.measurement_status: Provisional image evidence; not safe for automatic CAD import

records.title: Upper crosswise nub section
records.interpretation: Crosswise capture across both nubs near their upper ends. Exact Y station is unrecorded.
records.purpose: Nub flank shape and separation at this station.
records.caveat: The molded 100 mm ruler span is about 570 image pixels; the paper calibration bar is about 512 pixels. Their scales differ by about 11%.
records.measurement_status: Provisional image evidence; not safe for automatic CAD import

records.title: Second crosswise nub section
records.interpretation: Crosswise capture across both nubs. It appears lower than P4; exact Y and whether this was a repeat are unrecorded.
records.purpose: Compare nub flanks with P4; do not treat the two as repeatability measurements without station confirmation.
records.caveat: Both crowns are steeper than P4 in the image. This could reflect station, seating, or tilt as well as true surface variation.
records.measurement_status: Provisional image evidence; not safe for automatic CAD import

records.title: Crosswise section with unequal features
records.interpretation: Crosswise capture at a different height on the pad. The gauge appears reversed in the placement photo relative to the grid photo.
records.purpose: Local end/side transition evidence. Resolve console left/right before assigning either feature to a nub.
records.caveat: The far edge is cropped; the near silhouette is extracted. Do not read image-left as console-left.
records.measurement_status: Provisional image evidence; not safe for automatic CAD import

records.title: Longitudinal lower transition
records.interpretation: Lengthwise/oblique capture near the lower pad and long center nub. Exact X station and which surface the pins follow are uncertain.
records.purpose: Evidence of longitudinal change approaching the crease; identify the abrupt step before modeling it as a real surface.
records.caveat: The abrupt end step may include a boundary or non-contact pins. It is retained in the raw silhouette but not interpreted as CAD.
records.measurement_status: Provisional image evidence; not safe for automatic CAD import

records.title: Lower crosswise wall / nub section
records.interpretation: Crosswise capture in the lower region: a broad left-side feature and a narrow right-side feature. Exact Y station is unrecorded.
records.purpose: Left boundary blend and long-nub cross-section near its lower region.
records.caveat: The left feature reaches the gauge end and is only partially captured; it must not automatically be classified as the short nub.
records.measurement_status: Provisional image evidence; not safe for automatic CAD import

records.title: Lower-left corner, oblique section
records.interpretation: Oblique capture through the lower-left corner. Section angle, contact height, and exact origin are unrecorded.
records.purpose: Compound corner blend. This is evidence for a smooth transition, not a direct measurement of a plan-view fillet radius.
records.caveat: A single diagonal section cannot reconstruct the whole 3D corner or prove the current R15 outline.
records.measurement_status: Provisional image evidence; not safe for automatic CAD import
